hypothesis: After ten exploratory calls, two reserved finalization calls can preserve the archived task-1 native selection quality with fewer model tokens.
success: A finalization-start event, valid native selection with File-F1 and Span-F1 no worse than the archived ARE task-1 result, fewer known model tokens, and no unknown-usage requests.
claim_ceiling: One exposed ARE-only development rerun; no matched-pair, fresh-cohort, or superiority claim.
open_questions: Will finalization activate before voluntary selection?
Will the native quality survive the cutoff and reduce cost?
Would any exposed benefit transfer to a fresh paired cohort?
